recipes.title: Object workbench
recipes.summary: Keep a queue and the selected object in one working context.
recipes.use_when: People repeatedly select objects and act on their details.
recipes.avoid_when: The task is mostly reading a single long document.
recipes.rationale: Preserved context reduces repeated navigation while objects change.
composition: Show object identity and status before metadata.
Keep list selection and detail actions stable.
At narrow widths use a clear back path that restores selection.

type_roles.heading: Use existing compact heading roles.
type_roles.body: Keep detail prose readable at the product body size.
type_roles.data: Align comparable values and preserve identifiers.

recipes.title: Comparable data table
recipes.summary: Use columns to compare records and preserve row identity.
recipes.use_when: People scan the same attributes across many records.
recipes.avoid_when: Records have unrelated shapes or mostly long narrative content.
recipes.rationale: Shared alignment makes differences easier to locate than separate cards.
composition: Place identity in a stable first column.
Keep sort, filter and selection state visible.
Expose overflow values and actions to keyboard and pointer.

type_roles.heading: Keep section titles subordinate to the data.
type_roles.data: Use tabular figures for comparable numbers.

recipes.title: Operational monitoring
recipes.summary: Lead with exceptions, freshness and the next useful action.
recipes.use_when: People watch changing system states and investigate exceptions.
recipes.avoid_when: The screen is a periodic narrative report.
recipes.rationale: A stable visual structure helps readers distinguish new evidence from layout movement.
composition: Show timestamp and units next to each current value.
Group exceptions by action or affected system.
Preserve historical context and provide a text/table view of charts.

type_roles.heading: Use concise status headings.
type_roles.data: Align units and use tabular numbers; do not rely on color alone.

recipes.title: Multi-section form
recipes.summary: Group decisions and keep entered values through recovery.
recipes.use_when: People provide several related pieces of information.
recipes.avoid_when: The task needs one immediate search or command.
recipes.rationale: Clear groups and recovery paths reduce repeated entry without hiding required decisions.
composition: Group fields by the decision they support.
Put instructions before the affected field.
Keep inline errors, a linked summary when needed, and input on failed save.

type_roles.heading: Use short group headings.
type_roles.body: Keep labels, hints and errors legible.
type_roles.data: Use the native input font and distinguish read-only values.

recipes.title: Preference settings
recipes.summary: Make each setting, its effect and its save state clear.
recipes.use_when: People change persistent preferences or account configuration.
recipes.avoid_when: A consequential multi-step process needs staged review.
recipes.rationale: Exposing effects and save state prevents uncertain or accidental changes.
composition: Group controls by the behavior they change.
State whether changes save immediately or need confirmation.
Keep pending, failed and restored values visible.

type_roles.heading: Use existing section hierarchy.
type_roles.data: Align related labels and retain native control semantics.

recipes.title: Long-form reading
recipes.summary: Prioritize reading rhythm, source context and a useful text measure.
recipes.use_when: The main task is sustained reading.
recipes.avoid_when: The main task is comparing many short records.
recipes.rationale: A calm reading column lets structure and language carry the hierarchy.
composition: Keep body measure and line height comfortable with real text.
Use headings that explain the argument.
Keep links, captions and source context accessible.

type_roles.heading: Use an existing serif role if the product has one.
type_roles.body: Use the established reading font and size.
type_roles.data: Keep dates and references secondary but legible.

recipes.title: Technical documentation
recipes.summary: Connect a navigable hierarchy to exact examples and reference details.
recipes.use_when: People need to locate instructions or precise technical facts.
recipes.avoid_when: The page exists mainly to persuade a first-time buyer.
recipes.rationale: Location and examples should remain clear while readers move between overview and detail.
composition: Expose current location and related sections.
Keep examples near the concepts they demonstrate.
Make long code and tables reachable without breaking the page.

type_roles.heading: Use a clear heading ladder.
type_roles.body: Preserve readable prose and descriptive links.
type_roles.data: Use the existing monospace role for code, not for every label.

recipes.title: Product comparison
recipes.summary: Keep product differences, prices and purchase conditions comparable.
recipes.use_when: People assess options before choosing a product.
recipes.avoid_when: An editorial story is the primary task.
recipes.rationale: Consistent comparison facts help people choose without decoding decorative differences.
composition: Keep identity, price, units and availability together.
Use consistent image bounds and truthful option descriptions.
Show selection, added-item feedback and recovery on failed action.

type_roles.heading: Use the existing product-title role.
type_roles.body: Keep descriptions concise and conditions visible.
type_roles.data: Align prices and units; label discounts explicitly.

recipes.title: Plan selection
recipes.summary: Explain plan differences and commitments before the action.
recipes.use_when: People compare service plans with different constraints.
recipes.avoid_when: The product has one fixed-price action with no comparison.
recipes.rationale: Comparable limits and terms matter more than giving each option equal decoration.
composition: Align the facts that differ across plans.
Expose billing period, limits and material conditions.
Preserve the comparison and action when columns stack.

recipes.title: Search and retrieval
recipes.summary: Keep the query, result identity and refinement path together.
recipes.use_when: People find specific records or refine a collection.
recipes.avoid_when: The collection is small and predictable enough for direct navigation.
recipes.rationale: Visible query state and informative result summaries help readers judge relevance.
composition: Show active query and refinements.
Distinguish no records from no matches and failed retrieval.
Preserve selection and search context when opening a result.

type_roles.heading: Use result headings that identify their object.
type_roles.body: Show relevant snippets without inventing relevance.
type_roles.data: Keep counts and selected facets readable.

recipes.title: Conversation and drafting
recipes.summary: Support reading, composing and inspecting a response in one stable flow.
recipes.use_when: People exchange messages and may inspect attached evidence.
recipes.avoid_when: A deterministic form better expresses the required input.
recipes.rationale: Stable reading position and clear pending/error state protect the ongoing conversation.
composition: Keep draft text through navigation and failed sends.
Make streaming, cancellation and retry state explicit.
Keep long code, tables and citations reachable.

type_roles.heading: Use thread and section headings sparingly.
type_roles.body: Use the existing reading font for messages.
type_roles.data: Keep code and evidence labels distinct without weakening contrast.

recipes.title: First useful action
recipes.summary: Help a new user complete the first task that makes the product useful.
recipes.use_when: The user needs initial context or configuration before normal work.
recipes.avoid_when: Regular users already understand the task and need speed.
recipes.rationale: An observable first outcome gives setup steps a clear purpose.
composition: Name the first useful outcome.
Ask only for information needed for that outcome.
Provide a resumable path and explain what remains after interruption.

type_roles.heading: Use task-specific headings.
type_roles.body: Give short reasons for required inputs.
type_roles.data: Show progress in words and preserve entered configuration.
